technique.jaymospowers.zfighter.instant_: A late technique for the B key, in place of Flash Step. Tap B: you are at the block you look at, up to 64 blocks off. Hold B for a second: pick a friend or master whose ki you sensed in the last day and appear beside them. Costs a lot of ki; 20 s to recharge.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_senses.tele: Friends and masters whose ki you sensed in the last day
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_teleport_o: Instant Teleport is on %s. Tap to jump where you look; hold to pick someone.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_teleport_n: Nothing to land on in sight.
You have sensed no one lately. Turn on ki sense near the one you want to reach.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_teleport_l: Their ki has faded from your memory.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_teleport_h: Their ki is hidden from you.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_lend_recei: %s is pouring their ki into you.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_lend_apart: The ki stops flowing: too far apart.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_lend_empty: You have no ki left to lend.
